summary_en: FY3/26 year-end dividend raised from ¥30 to ¥33 per share (+10.0%). Annual dividend raised from ¥61 to ¥64. Prior-year (FY3/25) paid ¥55 total (¥27 interim + ¥28 year-end).
title_en: Notice regarding modification (increase) of dividend forecast for fiscal year ending September 2026
translation_en_brief: Koryojyuhan Co., Ltd. announced on 10 August 2026 a modification to its FY3/26 dividend forecast. The company increased the year-end dividend from the previously forecast ¥30 per share to ¥33 per share, an increase of 3 yen (10.0%). This raised the full-year dividend forecast from ¥61 to ¥64 per share. The modification was made based on recent operational performance trends. The company stated that stable and sustainable shareholder returns are a core management priority, supported by strengthened earnings capacity. FY3/25 (prior year) dividends totalled ¥55 per share (interim ¥27 + year-end ¥28).
